items.title: Duke Energy (DUK) Could Be 13% Undervalued As Regulatory Questions Build
items.summary: Regulatory moves put Duke Energy in focus Duke Energy (DUK) has moved to intervene in a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission proceeding involving PJM Interconnection, while also facing scrutiny in Florida over how its tariffs treat large load customers.
